leftEvidence.title: Holy things and pearls require discernment

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus warns against giving what is holy to dogs or throwing pearls before pigs.
points.right: Jesus warns about false prophets whose outward appearance hides predatory character.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Trampling and violent reversal are the named risks.
points.right: Good and corrupt trees are distinguished by fruit, and fruitless trees face fire.

payload.posture: Both sayings require attention to danger and outcome.

rightEvidence.title: False prophets are known by fruit

payload.tension: Dogs, pigs, false prophets, and fruit remain metaphors with different targets and evidence limits.
payload.title: Discernment after the warning against judgment
